overall: Well-structured balanced ethical analysis with stakeholder focus and external cases. Compelling Not Ship recommendation justified by public safety and long-term reputation, though quantification and visual support could improve.

feedback.summary: You produced a well-structured, balanced analysis with clear stakeholder focus. Your To Ship / Not To Ship structure in DISCUSSION and The Most Ethical Path compellingly justified Not Ship on public safety and trust. Your INTRODUCTION excels. To raise your overall grade, add quantitative evidence and visual support to strengthen research depth and report format.
next_steps: Add quantitative evidence in The Most Ethical Path: include estimated failure rates, recall costs, and VW/Apple fine figures to complement your qualitative BBC/NHS HSSIB case.
Create 1-2 visual elements: a stakeholder impact matrix and a risk-severity table for health department patients to move C5 beyond limited visuals.
Expand references from 4 to 6-8 reputable sources with Harvard formatting and integrate data citations in-text to reach Excellent for C4.

criteria.C1: Excellent work. In INTRODUCTION you identified several issues - public safety, data loss, integrity - linked to product quality, and listed stakeholders from Rachel to hospitals. You demonstrated context: 'maintaining product quality safety while trying to succeed as a business'. Keep this depth.
criteria.C2: Excellent balanced debate. Your DISCUSSION: To Ship or Not to Ship objectively argued market advantage and job security versus harm and reputation, then concluded in The Most Ethical Path with stakeholder-specific decisions for Rachel and the company. Well done.
criteria.C3: Excellent compelling argument. Your logical flow To Ship / Not To Ship / The Most Ethical Path builds systematically to CONCLUSION: 'decision to Not Ship is certainly the most ethical path.' You showed impact across the supply chain to end-users. Maintain this structure.
criteria.C4: Good use of 4 sources - EA Code, HSSIB investigation, VW scandal, Apple - in The Most Ethical Path and References. To reach Very good/Excellent, you need both qualitative AND quantitative evidence and more in-depth research with failure-rate data and cost figures.
criteria.C5: Good fluency and clear sections from ABSTRACT to RECOMMENDATION with Harvard-like citations. You are at Good because you have no figures/tables and only few references. For Very good, add 2+ visual elements and use several relevant references competently.
